generators.carrier: Q(i)^N cyclic clock shift, period N
Q(i)^d unitary step with U_S^N = I_d
W = S_C tensor U_S on Q(i)^N tensor Q(i)^d
D = sum_t |t><t| tensor U_S^t, t in Z/N

relations.statement: U_S^N = I_d, so U_S^t depends only on t mod N and D is well defined on the cyclic clock
relations.hypotheses: U_S^N = I_d; clock period N explicit; N >= 1

relations.statement: D W D^-1 = I tensor U_S (clock shift dressed away)
relations.hypotheses: U_S unitary; U_S^N = I_d; S_C|t> = |t+1> cyclic mod N

relations.statement: discreteEvolution u (j+k) = discreteEvolution u j * discreteEvolution u k; integer powers of the step form a group action

lemmas.statement: With U_S^N = I_d, D W D^-1 = I_N tensor U_S, so W is gauge-equivalent to the pure system step. Finite N and the hypothesis are explicit.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem D_conj_W (N d : ℕ) (SC US D : Matrix (Fin N × Fin d) (Fin N × Fin d) ℚ) (h : US ^ N = 1) : True := by sorry

near_misses.claim: D is well defined without U_S^N = I_d
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: U_S^N not equal to I_d makes U_S^t differ for t and t+N, so D is not well defined on Z/N
